title: The 3 Best Space Heaters Under $40
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for space heaters under $40, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at space heaters under $40 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Lasko 754200 Desktop Ceramic Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 9.2-inch compact desktop design, Adjustable thermostat, 2 heat settings plus fan-only mode.
strengths: One of the least expensive space heaters with a genuine adjustable thermostat
Compact enough for a desk, nightstand, or small room
Ready to use straight out of the box, no assembly needed
Large ratings history gives confidence in long-term reliability
limitations: No oscillation, only heats the direction it's pointed
Noticeably louder fan than premium models on the high setting

products.name: Lasko CT16450 Ceramic Space Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 15.7-inch compact ceramic heater, 1500W element, Adjustable thermostat.
strengths: Taller than a desktop model, warming more of a seated body
Adjustable thermostat gives more control than fixed-only competitors at this price
limitations: Some owners report a low buzzing sound during operation

products.name: Amazon Basics 500W Ceramic Personal Space Heater
strengths: Low 500W draw is easy on circuits
limitations: Only warms a personal space, not a room

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
